title: Companion Co-Pilot terminal handoff
description: Opens the persistent Co-Pilot through native Companion navigation and proves it resolves to the gateway-owned tmux worker.

proofTargets.claim: Companion opens the exact gateway-owned Co-Pilot terminal worker.

wait-advanced-tab.intent: Ensure native tab navigation is available.

open-advanced.intent: Open Advanced through native tab navigation.

open-copilot.intent: Ask Companion to resolve the persistent Co-Pilot from the gateway.

wait-terminal.intent: Prove the routed terminal is the exact gateway-owned Co-Pilot worker.

capture-terminal.label: Gateway-owned Co-Pilot terminal
capture-terminal.intent: Let the operator verify that Companion opened the retained Co-Pilot context rather than a different worker.
